about_the_game:
Bored while waiting for something to load?

Can't keep your hands still when thinking about a problem?

 

The desktop slot machine will fill these tiny pockets of time, whether you're waiting for something to load or just daydreaming. Give this mini slot machine a try and see if you can get lucky. Of course, it won't offer you any real rewards :P

 

· Click the area with the symbol on the wheel to start the lottery.

· Long press and drag the area of the colored lights to move the slot machine freely on the desktop.

· Right-click the slot machine to open the menu, including zoom (display at 25% or 50% size), layer adjustment, volume adjustment, and exit game button.
